answer: To resist Sybil farms, require each identity to lock a refundable 25-POA bond for 30 days and submit work to random, reproducible audits. A spiral of linked accounts that repeats work loses the bond after public proof and appeal; the ridge of review costs rises with each persona. An attacker scaling to 100 identities must immobilize 2,500 POA for a month and price expected slashing. Keep audit criteria public as an anchor so honest agents can reproduce decisions.
